regions.name: THE AMERICAS
regions.text: Sales of built housing units fell to 3.75m in October, down 8.8% from last year.

regions.name: ASIA
regions.text: The Japanese yen dropped near 160 against the US dollar.

regions.name: MIDDLE EAST
regions.text: OPEC+ oil output rebounded by 2.04 million barrels per day amid tanker rates hitting a record.

cover_dek: Digital currency slid as a technology executive stepped down.
big_headline: Bitcoin fell to $71,200 after Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang resigned.
big_body: Crypto positions worth $750 million were liquidated, meaning forced sales occurred. MSCI also confirmed Strategy's removal from its index.
pol_body: Competitive bids received for 91-day treasury bills reached an amount of 27,046.800 crore rupees. Competitive bids accepted amounted to 7,600.000 crore rupees.
biz_body: The cost of a new vehicle in the US climbed to a record high, pushing American drivers deeper into debt as loan rates stay high.
up_body: Israel Discount Bank allows eligible customers aged 18 and older to buy, hold and sell bitcoin and ether in its app starting on 26 November.
